rows.stdout:
usage: carnot [-h]
              {verify,verify-code,verify-batch,score,score-candidates,memory}
              ...

Carnot EBM verification CLI

positional arguments:
  {verify,verify-code,verify-batch,score,score-candidates,memory}
                        Available commands
    verify              Verify a Python function against test cases and
                        properties
    verify-code         Verify a Python function with packaged static checks
                        and optional PBT
    verify-batch        Verify a candidate batch with optional certified
                        abstention
    score               Score activations using a pre-trained EBM from
                        HuggingFace
    score-candidates    Score candidate outputs with the calibrated second-
                        pair detector
    memory              Import, export, and diff portable SessionMemory packs

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
